interest: Index on Japan's 1941 demand for naval bases in Indochina.
overview: Docket (1941): Japan's demands on France for air and naval bases at Saigon, reported from Chungking and Tokyo.

subfiles.about: A Department of State list of papers cataloging cross-referenced documents regarding Japanese demands for naval and air bases in French Indochina in 1941.
subfiles.summary: Lists two 1941 telegrams: Chinese intelligence on Japanese base demands at Saigon, and British-sourced reports on demands on France.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Japanese Naval Base in Indo-China
